metadata.scope: Thailand venues hosting Luxury Brands refresh POS
metadata.source_row_grain: Brand × venue × channel POS; a footprint is the host building, not each boutique unit
limitations: Original footprints only; no rectangles, circles, nearest-building replacements or simulated shapes.
Point containment is conditional on source/provider coordinate accuracy; it does not prove the legal address, floor, unit or entrance.
Height values are source or model estimates, not survey measurements. Unknown height remains null; 3 m is display fallback only.
For complexes, original production part baseM/topM values are preserved. No tallest-tower height is spread across the full host footprint.
Buildings without an unambiguous original polygon remain unmatched. Source presence and closure status are controlled by the POS filter.
Four individually reviewed Song Wat model heights remain in height_m but are withheld from extrusion pending validation; display height is 3 m and is not a corrected height.
